subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
If amplifiers 1 and 2 are interchanged, what will be 
the noise figure of cascade? 
 
(a) 4 dB 
(b) 6 dB 
 
(c) 40 dB 
(d) 0.6 dB 
 
Common Data for Q.No-27 & 28 
An attenuator with loss L >> 1 is followed by an amplifier 
with noise figure F and gain Ga = L
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-07 (Noise In Communication).
